caption:
ChatGPT can make up sources. Catch it in 10 seconds.

Ask for source links, open them, compare with a second tool.

Safer prompt: Answer only if you are sure. Give a source link for every number. If unsure, say not sure.

Save this fact-check trick. Has AI ever fooled you? Tell us below.
